bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a nonprofit to create a credit union; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. CREDIT UNION FOR THE UNDERSERVED; APPROPRIATION.

(a) $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to a nonprofit to create a federally chartered credit union or a state-chartered credit union operating under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 52. This is a onetime appropriation.

(b) The credit union created by this grant must:

(1) be designed to serve low-income individuals with limited access to or experience with traditional banking services;

(2) provide deposit, investment, and loan services that meet the needs of the community in a responsible and culturally appropriate manner; and

(3) operate at least one physical location where credit union members can access these services.

(c) By February 15, 2028, the commissioner shall submit a report on grant activities and quantifiable outcomes to the chairs and ranking minority members of the committees of the house of representatives and senate with jurisdiction over economic development.
